column1: # Libraries compiled into the jkit binary: the runtime dependencies of jkit-cli, minus jkit's own
# modules. packaging/third-party-notices.sh builds THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES from this table, and its
# --check mode (run in CI) fails when Maven resolves a different set than the one listed here.
# Tab-separated: group:artifact, version, SPDX license, copyright line, project URL, then the
# notice and license files to reproduce verbatim, comma-separated. A file is a jar entry
# (META-INF/...) of that artifact, or a path under packaging/third-party/ for texts the jar lacks.
# The Apache-2.0 text is reproduced once at the end, so Apache jars list only their NOTICE.
